<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the only upfield signals (≈10–40 ppm) that correspond to aliphatic carbons are at 37.50 ppm, 36.39 ppm, and 26.41 ppm. These three distinct signals represent three methyl carbons, indicating three methyl groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
